name: Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Ltd
title: Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Ltd - 544286 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Niva Bupa FY26 GWP up 27.4% to ₹9,433 cr with IFRS combined ratio improving 160bp to 101.4% on expense ratio cut to 33.7%; management targets ~99% COR by FY29, but commission regulation is an open overhang.

triggers.label: IFRS COR ~99% by FY29
triggers.quote: our model says it should be, let's say, 99% or so in FY '29

triggers.label: Retail growth 35%; H2 >40%
triggers.quote: our retail health growth for the same period was in excess of 40%

triggers.label: Ticket size up ~14.5% H2 vs H1
triggers.quote: Last 6 months versus first 6 months, the ticket size has grown by almost 14%, 14.5%

triggers.label: Commission regulation overhang
triggers.quote: we await guidance from the authority in terms of how they would like to move forward

guidance.quote: our model says it should be, let's say, 99% or so in FY '29
on the retail side, 17% to 19% CAGR if you take a 5 -year view
the idea is to get to maybe 5,000 in the next 4, 5 months

red_flags.label: Commission cap / EOM regulation risk
red_flags.quote: we await guidance from the authority in terms of how they would like to move forward

red_flags.label: Onerous contract provisions in group book
red_flags.quote: On 31st December, yes, there was loss component. And around equal amount was there last financial year also.

evasions.topic: Retail claims ratio trend and quality
evasions.quote: in terms of target, I don't think we want to target the claims ratio that operates below where we are
we are confident that whatever the authority comes up with we will make sure that the distribution is appropriately remunerated
